description: This source file defines data structures and a singleton class for managing a list of network-connected nodes. It includes the NodeInfo data model, NodeListResponse for decoding server responses, and NodesStore for fetching and maintaining node data asynchronously, including start/stop mechanisms and error handling.

classes.name: NodesStore
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing a list of NodeInfo objects, periodically refreshing data from a remote source, handling start/stop control, and error logging.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the periodic refresh loop for nodes, ensuring only one loop runs at a time.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the periodic refresh loop if it is running.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of nodes asynchronously from the server, updating local state and handling errors.
